open_points.subject: Imported ArtifactPointer type and owner service
open_points.text: “The first release declares one: `estimate` by PresuPro” conflicts with import keeping projects “with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept), links intact” and with the v1 sets containing “`estimate` by PresuPro and Kernel's types”; the text does not say what happens when an imported pointer has an undeclared type or an `owner_service` different from the declared owner.
open_points.question: May the one-time import bring in a pointer whose legacy type is not `estimate`, or whose legacy `owner_service` is not PresuPro, and if so what type and owner-service facts does that pointer have after import?
options: Refuse the whole import if any selected pointer is not `estimate` owned by PresuPro
Grandfather legacy pointer types and owner-service facts even though they are outside the first-release vocabulary
Import every pointer but derive or rewrite its owner service from the current vocabulary
Omit incompatible pointers from the import despite the requirement to keep pointers and links intact
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the whole import unless every imported pointer conforms to the declared `estimate`/PresuPro mapping.
